title: Settings
description: Your preferences, access, agency people and AI providers.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.languageHint: Only changes what you see. Client deliverables keep the language chosen for each client or content.
preferences.emailNotificationsHint: Each new notification arrives by email too, unless you already read it here. Off by default.
preferences.emailNotificationsNoSmtp: Email is not set up on this instance yet: an Admin can configure it in Settings › Email (SMTP).

providers.title: AI providers
providers.hint: Keys are set in the server’s .env file. The only costs are the providers’ API charges.

aiProviders.title: AI providers
aiProviders.description: Commercial use of generated images: an Admin verifies it by reading the provider’s terms.
aiProviders.unused: Not used: only the first two configured providers are tried (order set by IMAGE_PROVIDERS).
aiProviders.available: Available for clients whose policy allows it.
aiProviders.unavailable: Not used with real clients: image generation is off for every client.

hint.higgsfield: Uses the credits of your Higgsfield subscription. You log in on Higgsfield; Forgecy never sees the password.
hint.weave: Runs Figma Weave models through Figma’s MCP server and spends Weave credits (Starter plan or higher, Figma account linked in Weave). At most {max} credits per image.

result.error: The connection did not complete: see the last error on the provider.

errors.noEncryptionKey: Set FORGECY_ENCRYPTION_KEY in .env first: it encrypts the login tokens.
errors.startFailed: The provider did not accept the connection. Check the server address in .env and try again.

siwc.title: Sign in with ChatGPT
siwc.description: Connect your own ChatGPT account instead of using the agency's OpenAI API key for your requests.

planSharing.active: Your ChatGPT plan is used for eligible requests.
planSharing.pending: Plan sharing is not available yet: OpenAI has not published this for third-party apps. Connecting only confirms your identity today; requests still use the agency's OpenAI API key.

notConfigured.title: Awaiting OpenAI approval
notConfigured.description: OpenAI currently issues a client id only to approved partners. Request one at developers.openai.com/siwc/request-client-id; once granted, enter it below (or set OPENAI_SIWC_CLIENT_ID in .env) to turn this on.

result.error: The connection did not complete: see the last error above.

errors.notConfigured: OpenAI has not issued a client id yet.
errors.startFailed: ChatGPT did not accept the connection. Try again.

routing.title: Services and models
routing.description: Choose which service and which model Forgecy uses. Changes apply to new jobs within a few seconds.
routing.modelHint: Leave the model empty for the service’s default. With OpenRouter use its model ids, e.g. deepseek/deepseek-chat or openai/gpt-6.1-sol.
routing.imagesHint: Number the services in the order to try them; the first two ready ones are used (primary and fallback). “Off” never uses that service.
routing.invalid: Check the choices: each service can appear only once.
